title: Regional pool snapshot — daily rollup (2026-03-12)
content:
Sheet export: daily rollup table (UTC)

Columns:
Date, Region, Cluster, Pool, PoolType, TotalGPUs, AllocatedGPUs, UtilizationPct, AvgSeqLen, P50LatencyMs, P95LatencyMs, Evictions, Notes

Rows:
2026-03-12, us-west1, cluster-w-usw-01, pool-tx-infer-1, transformer, 128, 112, 87.5, 256, 32, 98, 1, steady traffic spike 06:00-07:30 UTC; small preemptions on node group 4
2026-03-12, us-west1, cluster-w-usw-01, pool-embed-2, embedding, 64, 40, 62.5, 128, 12, 26, 0, background batch jobs throttled 03:00-04:00
2026-03-12, us-east1, cluster-e-use-03, pool-chat-3, chat, 96, 96, 100.0, 64, 20, 85, 4, sustained full allocation — investigate autoscale margin
2026-03-12, eu-west1, cluster-eu-ldn-02, pool-mix-1, mixed, 64, 36, 56.3, 144, 18, 44, 0, moderate utilization; one pod evicted for OOM on node 11 (investigate model size/quantization mismatch)
2026-03-12, ap-southeast1, cluster-ap-sg-01, pool-dedicated-1, reserved, 32, 8, 25.0, 320, 45, 120, 0, reserved pool underutilized after canary shift
2026-03-12, us-central1, cluster-ctr-03, pool-burst-4, burst, 48, 44, 91.7, 200, 28, 110, 2, short-lived burst between 17:10-17:22 UTC correlated with marketing campaign throttles

Derived metrics (daily):
- Fleet-wide weighted utilization: 78.1% (sum Allocated / sum Total across pools)
- Regions over 90%: us-east1 (100%), us-west1 (87.5%), us-central1 (91.7%)
- Eviction count: 7 total; 4 in us-east1 (chat pool), 1 node OOM in eu-west1, 2 preemptions in us-west1/us-central1
- Average p95 latency fleet-wide: 80ms

Quick interpretation / operational notes:
- us-east1 chat pool is at 100% allocation for the full day. This is the second consecutive daily snapshot at or near 100% and coincides with increased P95 latency and 4 evictions. Recommend immediate mitigation: enable burst spillover to compatible model variant in us-west1 or trigger short-term capacity add (reserve 16 GPUs) while we investigate root cause.
- us-west1 shows high utilization with small preemptions. Looks like spot instance churn on node group 4; request infra to move critical chat nodes to non-preemptible or increase tolerance by shifting lower priority batches to embedding pools during 06:00-08:00 UTC.
- eu-west1 node OOM suggests one of the recent quantization builds may have regressed memory estimates for the medium model. Flagging to applied-ml to validate the 4-bit quant artifacts tied to PR #5423.
- ap-southeast reserved pool is low — can absorb planned canary traffic from upcoming APAC marketing test next week. Recommend temporary re-route of 10% of burst requests from us-central1 to ap-southeast1 to relieve us-central pressure on peak window.

Action items (owner, ETA):
- Marcus Li: open emergency capacity ticket and request +16 GPUs in us-east1 (JIRA-2026) — ETA 2026-03-13 10:00 UTC
- Priya Nair: validate recent quant builds and run stress memtest on eu-west1 model images (linked GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/5423) — ETA 2026-03-14
- Aisha Thompson (SRE): review spot instance eviction logs for us-west1 nodegroup-4 and propose nodegroup config change — ETA 2026-03-13 EOD
- Diego Marquez: create routing rule for 10% APAC spillover and test with canary traffic — ETA 2026-03-15

Risks and escalation notes:
- If us-east1 remains at 100% longer than 12 hours, customer SLAs for Dedicated tenants may be at risk. Escalate to on-call infra lead and CS owners if no capacity is added within 6 hours.
- Multiple small evictions across clusters may indicate a fleet-wide kernel or driver regression; if eviction rate increases > 10% day-over-day, pause rollout of last node image and revert to previous stable.

Links / dashboard references:
- Live rollup: https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/overview?date=2026-03-12
- Cluster details (us-east1): https://dash.redwood.internal/gpu/cluster/cluster-e-use-03
- Evictions log query: https://logs.redwood.internal/gpu/evictions?q=2026-03-12

Notes to self (raw):
- confirm whether chat pool saw traffic pattern change from promo endpoint — check /api/promotions route on 2026-03-12 16:00-18:00 UTC
- check whether autoscaler maxReplicas was capped incorrectly after yesterday's deploy (PR #7890)
- finish writeup for weekly infra sync (include this snapshot + trend charts)

End of sheet export.
